sections.head: Test the rest of your AI stack

items.a: AI agent testing checks how a chat, voice, phone, video or image agent behaves before and after release. Simulated users hold real conversations with the agent and every run is scored on quality metrics.

items.q: Which agents can TestMu AI test?
items.a: Agent Testing covers chatbots, voice agents, IVR systems, outbound calling agents, video agents and image-capable agents, on any vendor or in-house stack.
Chat and voice runs are scored on 9 metrics, including hallucination detection, bias and task completion. Phone calls are scored on 30+ metrics.
No. You connect an endpoint, phone number or web URL. Teams typically run a first suite in about 30 minutes.

items.q: Is Agent Testing the same as Agent Assurance?
items.a: No. Agent Testing covers agents that talk to people. Agent Assurance, delivered by Rook, tests agents that work with other agents, tools and APIs.
